inj.note: The rookie quarterback struggled in his third career start, but Daniels did connect with Emeka Egbuka on a two-yard score in the second quarter and had Tampa Bay in front 16-3 to begin the fourth. Once Aaron Rodgers began putting points on the board, though, Daniels buckled under the pressure and threw both his INTs. Baker Mayfield (thumb) has yet to return to practice, giving Daniels good odds of making his fourth straight start in Week 7 against the Panthers, but his 3:5 TD:INT since the veteran QB went down doesn't make him a very appealing fantasy option.

news.h: Bucs QB Jalon Daniels swaps jerseys with idol, Steelers QB Aaron Rodgers
news.d: Following Pittsburgh's 26-19 overtime victory, Jalon Daniels left with a keepsake from his idol, Aaron Rodgers.

news.h: Mayfield to practice this week but Buccaneers to prep as if Daniels will play
news.d: Baker Mayfield will return to practice Wednesday for the Buccaneers, but the team will prepare as if Jalon Daniels will start at QB, coach Todd Bowles said.

news.h: Undrafted rookie QB Daniels savors Thursday night win vs. Cowboys
news.d: Jalon Daniels became the first undrafted rookie starting QB in the common draft era to win a game for a team that entered winless, leading the Bucs to a 24-16 win over the Cowboys.

news.h: Buccaneers explode in third quarter against Cowboys to get first win
news.d: Undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels and Tampa Bay held off Dallas on "Thursday Night Football."

news.h: Bucky Irving and rookie QB Jalon Daniels help Bucs beat sloppy Cowboys 24-16 for 1st win of season
news.d: — Bucky Irving already had his first 100-yard game since his rookie year in 2024 when the Tampa Bay running back finished off the Dallas Cowboys with a run that gave him a career high.
